subject: Marketplace product page: accessibility fixes + co-sell readiness
messages:
From: Sara Lim <sara@heliotech.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft listing - accessibility items and co-sell prep

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. The Product team pulled together a quick pass at your marketplace product page copy and flagged a few accessibility concerns (contrast, alt text on AMI screenshot, and screen-reader headings). We also want to confirm what assets you need from us to meet AWS co-sell eligibility.

Can you share a checklist or a short doc with the items Redwood expects so we can prioritize? We attached our audit CSV and an AMI screenshot.

Cheers,
Sara
Product Ops | HelioTech
Attachments: accessibility_audit.csv (CSV), ami_screenshot.png (PNG)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Sara Lim <sara@heliotech.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft listing - accessibility items and co-sell prep

Hi Sara — great notes, thanks for sending. Attached is a working draft of the marketplace copy with inline comments (marketplace_copy_v2.docx). I also sketched a co-sell readiness checklist below to start: 

- AMI/AMI-ID and public/private visibility confirmation
- Accessibility fixes (alt text, color contrast >= 4.5:1 for body text)
- Trial entitlements and trial SKU configured
- Security evidence: SOC2 summary + contact for audit
- Pricing footnote and private offers contact
- 1-pager product brief for field co-sell

Can Kimberly and Mateo skim the copy for field-facing claims? I want to make sure we don't overstate latency/cost numbers. Next step: quick sync Monday to finalize assets for the marketplace intake.

Best,
Marissa
Sr. Partner Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: marketplace_copy_v2.docx (DOCX)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft listing - accessibility items and co-sell prep

Marissa — quick pass below (copied into thread for context):

1) Claims: change "ultra-low latency at scale" to "low-latency inference for production workloads" unless we have SLA-backed numbers. Mateo: any latency SLA we can cite for Dedicated?
2) Accessibility: Sara's team flagged the hero image lacking alt text — add descriptive alt and ensure the hero CTA is keyboard focusable.
3) Pricing: avoid percent-savings language; list base monthly price and link to private offer contact in purchase flow.
4) Co-sell collateral: request a one-page architecture diagram (AMI placement, VPC options) and a short success-wins list (3 bullets).

I updated the doc with inline suggestions (see marketplace_copy_v2.docx). Priyom, can you confirm the co-sell readiness gating — which items are required vs recommended for AWS field engagement? I'll help compile the evidence pack.

—Kimberly
Head of Marketplace Enablement | Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Sara Lim <sara@heliotech.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 17:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft listing - accessibility items and co-sell prep

Hi Sara — thanks for the quick turnaround. Action items and owners below: 

- HelioTech: fix alt text on hero + upload revised AMI screenshot (Sara) — due Wed 9/2
- HelioTech: confirm AMI visibility and provide AMI-ID (Sara) — due Wed 9/2
- Redwood (Priyom): prepare co-sell evidence pack checklist and draft 1-pager (Priyom) — due Fri 9/4
- Redwood (Kimberly): finalize claim language and pricing footnote; compile evidence links for intake form — due Fri 9/4
- Marissa: submit final listing assets to AWS intake and loop in AWS field lead for co-sell introduction (will do after 9/4)

We'll use the Drive folder I shared (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3Cmarketplace-copy) as the single source-of-truth. I'll also push the marketplace_copy_v2.docx with Kimberly's edits. Let me know if you'd like a 20-minute call Wednesday morning to walk through the final page.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live and into the AWS field pipeline.

Marissa
Sr. Partner Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0148
